method: Whole-file manual reading of IShellFolder.cs retrieved at exact commit via raw GitHub; Git blob SHA1 independently matched pinned inventory.
findings: ParseDisplayName is explicitly PreserveSig and returns int HRESULT. Previously reviewed GetPidlFromPath ignores this return and returns output PIDL directly; failure HRESULT does not itself become a managed exception through this declaration. This resolves v1/v2 uncertainty.

Two-string IsEquivalent overload does not check parsed PIDLs for nonzero before invoking CompareIds; mixed string/PIDL/target overload does check its newly parsed comparison PIDL. Invalid or failed parses therefore have inconsistent admission paths.

CompareIDs is PreserveSig and returns int; caller accepts only zero then falls back to case-insensitive URL names. Failure is not exposed distinctly to caller. No specific null-PIDL Shell outcome reproduced.
Interface skips three vtable methods through _VtblGap1_3 and declares no enumeration/binding implementation. This thin COM wrapper does not supply filesystem-content equality.
